title: mini-batcher sculptor + ledger-backed cost scout and quant slotter
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Customers with spiky traffic and tight unit-econ targets need deterministic, low-cost prefills while avoiding broad quantization rollouts that regress quality. This PR introduces a ledger-backed Cost Scout that records sampled prefill outcomes and a 'mini-batcher sculptor' that uses that ledger to synthesize safe, tenant-scoped mini-batch shapes. It also adds a conservative quantization slotter that suggests per-tenant quant slots (safe small steps) instead of global blanket changes.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces cost_scout service: a lightweight ledger that stores sampled prefill traces, per-tenant cost/latency histograms, and quality deltas derived from existing evals.
- Implements mini-batcher-sculptor: algorithmic component that proposes compact batch shapes (mini-batches) tuned for tenant latency SLOs and observed prefill hit rates. Sculptor uses a cost model that considers batching, KV cache hit probability, and quantization step impact.
- Adds quant-slotter: a staged quantization suggester that emits conservative candidate slots (e.g., FP16 -> q4_0 -> q4_1) with estimated cost/quality tradeoffs and rollback safety metadata.
- Plumbs telemetry: new prefill_events/v1 schema and dashboard-ready tags for cohort-level analysis.
- Exposes cli 'ecoctl scout export' to dump ledger slices for offline analysis and simulation.

Implementation notes: all core runtime changes are behind a feature flag (econ.scout.enabled=false by default). The sculptor runs as a periodic job in the prefill service; it writes candidate mini-batcher configs to a new /admin/preview endpoint. Quant-slotter is implemented as a library (runtime/quant/slotter) and only generates candidates; application of quant profiles is intentionally manual via the rollout API and flagged in telemetry.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for sculptor heuristics and cost model (runtime/prefill/*_test.go).
- Integration tests validate end-to-end ledger ingestion and sculptor preview generation (tests/integration/prefill_integration_test.py).
- Synthetic tenant replay harness used to verify that suggested mini-batches reduce per-token cost in 8/10 replayed scenarios and do not violate 95th percentile latency SLO in the evaluation harness.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge behind feature flag (this PR).
2) Enable scout for internal tenancy only and run for 2 weeks to collect ledger samples.
3) Run sculptor in dry-run mode and export candidates; review for regressions via the new dashboard.
4) If signal is positive, promote sculptor to opt-in tenant suggestions (admin preview), and only after manual approvals, allow autopilot application in canary mode (10% of tenant traffic).

Related work: ENG-1287 (prefill sampling improvements), ENG-1310 (quant safety guardrails). Related PRs: some overlapping telemetry work in pr-436789 and smaller prefill experiments in pr-73902.

Checklist: 
- [x] Core algorithm and cost model implemented.
- [x] Feature flag wiring and admin preview endpoint.
- [x] Telemetry schema and dashboard notes.
- [x] Unit and integration tests.
- [x] Docs: prefill playbook example added.

Notes: This PR focuses on safe candidate suggestion and visibility rather than automated global rollouts. The goal is to give SREs and Cost Ops a ledger they can interrogate and a predictable, tenant-aware batch shaping primitive that materially reduces per-token cost for bursty tenants without aggressive quant steps.

d4e5f6a: implement mini-batcher sculptor algorithm + unit tests
b7c8d9e: quant-slotter library and CLI export command; telemetry hooks
review_comments: Samir Patel: Nice focused design. Two asks: add a short-term TTL on ledger rows to avoid unbounded growth and ensure the ledger write path is async (don't add tail latency to request path).
Ava Martinez: Added TTL and switched append path to background worker; ledger writes now batch every 200ms. Updated tests to simulate worker backpressure.
Rina Cho: Can you add an integration check that ensures sculptor's suggested mini-batches do not increase 95p latency beyond 5% for existing tenants?
Ava Martinez: Added the 95p regression check to integration test harness; sculptor suggestions fail CI if regression detected in dry-run mode.
Liam O'Neill: Telemetry schema looks fine. Please include an index on tenant_id + window_start in the ledger DB migration.
Ava Martinez: DB migration updated with composite index; migration tested locally with the patch.
merge_details: Merged by Rina Cho (squash) on 2025-08-07 after 3 approvals. Merge commit message summarized the Cost Scout design and rollout plan.
release_notes: Introduce ledger-backed Cost Scout and mini-batcher sculptor; add quant-slotter for conservative per-tenant quant suggestions; feature-flagged behind econ.scout.enabled=false; new telemetry prefill_events/v1; admin preview endpoint for candidate inspection.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag default is off. If enabling for internal tenants, ensure DB retention policy configured (default 30d) and background writer has at least 2 replicas. Sculptor CPU usage measured ~12% of prefill service in internal perf tests; monitor sculptor.job.cpu and prefill.95p_latency when toggling.
